1. Measure your floor positions. Import positions.csv from Choose Position, or enter a position and both coordinates.

2. Set lens height, offsets and notes once in Mounting Setup. Add row time only when known for this camera and resolution. Keep the lens above the floor mark.

3. Align the preview with the ceiling LEDs. Wait for Camera ready, tap Start Capture and step away. Choose a frame count or duration in Settings → Recording. After a 3-second countdown, the app captures the selected length, then beeps and vibrates.

4. Review any warnings. Repeat keeps the previous attempt. Next Position follows the imported file order. Move the mount before starting again.

5. Open Sessions to share the data or save a file for USB transfer.
